governingStatute: Integrated Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (Act No. 13 of 2017)
statutorySection: Section 16 read with Section 2(6) and Section 13
successorStatute: Integrated Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (In Force)
title: Zero rated supply and export of services under Letter of Undertaking (LUT)

effectivePeriod.annualReset: LUT ARN renewed annually before 31st March for the upcoming financial year
effectivePeriod.sunsetNotes: Permanent zero-rating provision under IGST Act, 2017.

plainTextSummary: Under Section 16(1) of the IGST Act, zero-rated supply includes export of goods or services, or supplies to a Special Economic Zone (SEZ) developer or unit. Section 16(3) read with Rule 96A of the CGST Rules permits a registered person to export goods or services without payment of integrated tax (IGST) after furnishing a Letter of Undertaking (LUT in Form GST RFD-11). To qualify as an export of services under Section 2(6), five cumulative conditions must be satisfied: (1) supplier of service is located in India, (2) recipient of service is located outside India, (3) place of supply of service is outside India (determined under Section 13), (4) payment has been received in convertible foreign exchange or in Indian rupees wherever permitted by the Reserve Bank of India, and (5) supplier and recipient are not merely establishments of distinct persons. If any condition fails—such as intermediary services under Section 13(8)(b) where the place of supply is deemed to be the location of the supplier in India—zero-rating is denied and standard IGST applies. Exporters under LUT are entitled to claim a refund of unutilized Input Tax Credit (ITC) under Section 54(3).

keyStatutoryThresholds.lutRenewalRequirement: Annual renewal on GST portal in Form GST RFD-11 for each financial year
keyStatutoryThresholds.itcRefundEntitlement: Full refund of accumulated unutilized ITC under Section 54(3) of CGST Act
keyStatutoryThresholds.intermediaryServiceDisqualification: Intermediary services u/s 13(8)(b) have place of supply in India, disqualifying them from zero-rated export
keyStatutoryThresholds.gstrReportingTable: GSTR-1 Table 6A (Export invoices without payment of tax)

requiredDocumentChecklist: Active Letter of Undertaking (LUT) acknowledgement receipt (ARN) for the financial year
Export Invoices clearly endorsing 'SUPPLY MEANT FOR EXPORT UNDER LUT WITHOUT PAYMENT OF INTEGRATED TAX'
Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or Electronic Bank Realisation Certificate (e-BRC)
Service Level Agreement (SLA) or Master Services Agreement with foreign client proving non-intermediary status
GSTR-1 Table 6A and GSTR-3B monthly filing reconciliation
Form GST RFD-01 refund application with electronic statement of invoices and inward remittances
